name: Aniyah
purpose: Financial literacy, budgeting, credit education, entrepreneurship and cross-border money skills for families, youth and global TryAMM users, with regulated financial actions handed off to OmniPay and licensed providers.
positioning: Education-first financial empowerment app; not a bank, lender, broker or unlicensed money transmitter.
coreModules: FX, fees, duties and landed-cost education
family legacy and generational wealth education

ai.assistant: Aniyah AI powered through HoloGPT orchestration
capabilities: explain financial concepts in plain language
guardrails: no personalized investment advice unless routed to appropriately licensed service
high-risk financial actions require regulated provider flow and applicable consent

crossBorder.educationFlow: show amount -> destination -> FX -> provider/network fee -> taxes/duties where applicable -> recipient amount -> timing/risk explanation
crossBorder.regulatedActionRule: Actual money movement is executed only by eligible licensed providers through OmniPay/TapPay routing.

youthSafety: no high-risk credit/lending solicitation to minors
earned-learning badges instead of gambling-style mechanics
monetization: qualified referrals to regulated providers where lawful and disclosed
productionDependencies: regulated provider integrations for actual payments
